titleText: Only two schools from 105 have non-EU pupil majority, official data shows
mainText: From Times of Malta: Only two schools from 105 have non-EU pupil majority, official data shows. There are 7,750 non-EU students in government schools

titleText: Swieqi residents, council oppose plans to replace villa with offices
mainText: From Times of Malta: Swieqi residents, council oppose plans to replace villa with offices. Council questions application as residents fear development will change neighbourhood’s character

titleText: NAO warns fragmented government databases complicate compilation of Malta’s population statistics
mainText: From The Malta Independent: NAO warns fragmented government databases complicate compilation of Malta’s population statistics. The National Audit Office (NAO) has identified fragmented information flows, inconsistent validation practices and reliance on manual processes as challenges affecting the compilation of Malta's demographic statistics using administrative data.

titleText: Man handed suspended sentence after admitting to insulting Adrian Delia on Facebook
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Man handed suspended sentence after admitting to insulting Adrian Delia on Facebook. A 49-year-old man was handed a one-year prison sentence suspended for two years after admitting to publishing an insulting Facebook comment directed at Nationalist MP Adrian Delia and breaching conditions imposed on him when he was previously granted bail.

titleText: 69-year-old man sustains grievous injuries after Birkirkara collision
mainText: From MaltaToday: 69-year-old man sustains grievous injuries after Birkirkara collision. A 69-year-old man sustained grievous injuries in a collision on Dun Karm Street, Birkirkara, at around 5am on Monday. Preliminary investigations indicate that the collision involved a Toyota Yaris driven by an 88-year-old man from Birkirkara and an Audi A3 driven by a 35-year-old Croatian national.
